sections.text: An inversion within chromosome 2 joins EML4 to the ALK kinase region. The fusion has kinase-dependent transforming activity: expressing it produced fibroblast foci and tumors in mice, whereas a kinase-inactive mutant did not. It was detected in non-small-cell lung cancers.

report_comment.text: EML4 encodes a microtubule-associated protein with an amino-terminal oligomerization domain. ALK encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase involved in neural development. An inversion within chromosome 2 joins EML4 to the ALK kinase region. The fusion has kinase-dependent transforming activity: expressing it produced fibroblast foci and tumors in mice, whereas a kinase-inactive mutant did not. It was detected in non-small-cell lung cancers. ALK-positive metastatic NSCLC is eligible for ALK-directed kinase inhibition; alectinib also has a US adjuvant indication after resection of ALK-positive NSCLC, with the pivotal trial enrolling stage IB tumors at least 4 cm through stage IIIA disease.
